services.title: Islamic Jobs Portal
services.shortDescription: Find opportunities in Imamat, teaching, Azan, Khitabat and other Islamic positions.
services.fullDescription: A dedicated platform connecting Islamic institutions, mosques, and madaris with qualified scholars, Huffaz, Qaris, teachers, and Imams.

services.title: Mayaar-e-Madaris
services.shortDescription: A centralized academic and examination system connecting affiliated Madaris.
services.fullDescription: Comprehensive examination management, student portal, marksheets, verification and digital grade book for Islamic madrasas.

services.title: Online Academy
services.shortDescription: Learn Quran, Tajweed, Islamic studies and other subjects through online classes.
services.fullDescription: Interactive online classes with experienced Asatizah for Quran recitation, Tajweed, Darse Nizami basics and specialized subjects.

services.title: Daily Islamic Quiz
services.shortDescription: Test your Islamic knowledge through engaging quizzes, competitions and learning activities.
services.fullDescription: Engaging daily and weekly quiz competitions on Seerat-un-Nabi, Quran, Hadith, Fiqh and Islamic history for students and seekers.

services.title: Islamic Shopping Center
services.shortDescription: Explore Islamic clothing, books, prayer essentials, perfumes and other Islamic products.
services.fullDescription: Curated collection of authentic Islamic attire, attar/perfumes, prayer rugs, Qurans, classical Islamic texts and essentials.

services.title: Islamic Q&A
services.shortDescription: Explore Islamic questions and answers and find useful guidance on religious matters.
services.fullDescription: Authentic fatwas, clarifications and guidance on everyday spiritual, financial and personal issues verified by qualified Muftis.

services.title: Official Facebook Page
services.shortDescription: Connect with our official Facebook page for the latest updates, scholarly articles, and announcements.
services.fullDescription: The official Facebook page of Imamat wa Tadrees featuring daily Islamic articles, scholarly guidance, lectures, and educational announcements.
